description: This file defines the interface for pattern parsing and rendering in the lighttpd server, including type definitions, function prototypes, and callback signatures related to pattern processing.

methods.name: li_pattern_new
methods.description: Constructs a new liPattern object by parsing a provided string, returning NULL on error.

methods.name: li_pattern_free
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with an liPattern object.

methods.name: li_pattern_eval
methods.description: Evaluates a pattern in the context of a request, appending the result to the destination string.

methods.name: li_pattern_array_cb
methods.description: Default callback for processing a GArray of GString elements into a pattern result.

methods.name: li_pattern_regex_cb
methods.description: Default callback for processing regex match info into a pattern result.

ctags.name: liPatternCB
ctags.pattern: /^typedef void (*liPatternCB) (GString *pattern_result, guint from, guint to, gpointer data);$/
